title: Criminal Image Detection (Deep Learning + Flask)
summary: A CNN-based image classifier and Flask web app for categorizing criminal activity images into classes like chain-snatcher, drug dealer, kidnapper, and murderer. No SDV-family library is imported, called, or referenced anywhere in the code or dependencies.

needs: The 'req' hit pattern appears to be a false match on requirements.txt; no genuine SDV-family reference exists in this repo.
